title: Love In The Time Of Cholera

vibeProfile.oneLine: A man waits fifty-one years to love the woman he never stopped wanting.

summary: Florentino Ariza loves Fermina Daza for more than fifty years, waiting through her long marriage to a respectable doctor for the chance to declare himself again. Marquez turns this improbable, obsessive devotion into a sweeping meditation on love in all its forms, romantic, foolish, faithful and absurd, set against a fever-bright Caribbean city over half a century. Sensuous, funny and wise about desire and old age, it argues that love and its lovesickness can outlast almost anything, including good sense.
whyReadIt: A grand, sensuous love story that spans a lifetime and refuses to give up. Proof that Marquez could be as romantic as he was magical.

funFacts.text: Marquez said the love story was partly inspired by the long courtship of his own parents.
